semantics.read_during_write: Old word; all writes nonblocking at same edge
semantics.idle_read: Registered response holds when read enable is clear
semantics.bounds: Out-of-range reads return0 and writes are discarded
semantics.write_conflict: Last enabled writer wins: ME (ascending port/lane), matrix, SU (ascending lane), scalar, sequencer; retain priority or prove conflicts impossible
semantics.ME_clock: ME read/write only when me_clk_en; read delay XVM applies to ME path

vector_memory.physical_gate: Need source-pinned scheduled port activity/conflict proof, protected SRAM bank inventory and finite-flow interfaces. A narrow1R1W slice is not equivalent merely because it closes.

constant_table.address: 20-bit array index, full24-bit address checked against crom_words

constants.policy: No ROM ECC; preserve released payload, descriptor validity, full address bounds and transaction identity
constants.physical_gate: Pin actual program/descriptor/constant payload and live extent, then bank/replicate selected macro. Behavioral maximum array size alone is neither macro inventory nor exact transport proof.

su64_sfu.physical_gate: Cut lane-local chains without splitting feedback; retain shared reductions in golden tree order, independently price transport/serial domain. No new closure claim from isolated arithmetic.
